name: Apple___Apple_scab
cause: Fungus Venturia inaequalis. Favorable conditions are cool, wet weather.
cure: Apply preventive fungicides like captan or myclobutanil at early growth stages. Remove and destroy fallen leaves, prune for airflow, and plant resistant varieties.

name: Apple___Black_rot
cause: Caused by the fungus Botryosphaeria obtusa.
cure: Prune and burn infected branches and fruits. Apply protective fungicides during bloom and fruit development, and maintain orchard sanitation.

name: Apple___Cedar_apple_rust
cause: Fungus Gymnosporangium juniperi-virginianae. Requires junipers as an alternate host.
cure: Remove nearby juniper hosts if possible. Apply fungicides like myclobutanil during early leaf development and use resistant cultivars.

name: Apple___healthy
cure: Continue proper irrigation, balanced fertilization, pruning, and regular monitoring to maintain plant health.

name: Background_without_leaves
cure: No treatment required.

name: Blueberry___healthy
cure: Ensure acidic soil, proper mulching, regular watering, and periodic pruning for healthy growth.

name: Cherry___Powdery_mildew
cure: Apply sulfur or potassium bicarbonate sprays early. Improve air circulation through pruning and avoid overhead irrigation.

name: Cherry___healthy
cure: Maintain regular pruning, proper spacing, and balanced fertilization.

name: Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_spot
cure: Use resistant hybrids, rotate crops, and apply foliar fungicides at early disease stages.

name: Corn___Common_rust
cure: Plant resistant hybrids and apply fungicides if infection is severe. Ensure proper field sanitation.

name: Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight
cure: Use resistant varieties, rotate crops, and apply fungicides when symptoms first appear.

name: Corn___healthy
cure: Follow proper fertilization, irrigation, and crop rotation practices.

name: Grape___Black_rot
cure: Remove infected mummified berries and apply fungicides like mancozeb during early season.

name: Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles)
cure: Prune and destroy infected wood, protect pruning wounds, and maintain vine vigor through proper nutrition.

name: Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spot)
cure: Improve vineyard sanitation and apply recommended fungicides during humid conditions.

name: Grape___healthy
cure: Ensure proper pruning, trellising, irrigation, and nutrient management.

name: Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening)
cause: Bacterium Candidatus Liberibacter spp. Spread by psyllid insects.
cure: Remove infected trees immediately, control psyllids using approved insecticides, and plant certified disease-free saplings.

name: Peach___Bacterial_spot
cure: Apply copper sprays during dormancy, use resistant cultivars, and avoid overhead irrigation.

name: Peach___healthy
cure: Maintain proper pruning, fertilization, and watering schedules.

name: Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot
cure: Use certified disease-free seeds, apply copper-based bactericides, and practice crop rotation.

name: Pepper,_bell___healthy
cure: Ensure proper spacing, irrigation, and balanced fertilization.

name: Potato___Early_blight
cure: Apply fungicides such as chlorothalonil, rotate crops, and remove infected debris.

name: Potato___Late_blight
cure: Use certified disease-free seed tubers, apply protective fungicides, and destroy infected plants immediately.

name: Potato___healthy
cure: Maintain proper irrigation, fertilization, and crop rotation.

name: Raspberry___healthy
cure: Provide proper pruning, mulching, and irrigation management.

name: Soybean___healthy
cure: Follow crop rotation, soil fertility management, and regular monitoring.

name: Squash___Powdery_mildew
cure: Apply sulfur or neem oil sprays early and ensure good air circulation between plants.

name: Strawberry___Leaf_scorch
cure: Remove infected leaves, improve air circulation, and apply fungicides during wet conditions.

name: Strawberry___healthy
cure: Maintain proper spacing, mulching, and irrigation practices.

name: Tomato___Bacterial_spot
cure: Use disease-free seeds, apply copper sprays, rotate crops, and avoid overhead watering.

name: Tomato___Early_blight
cure: Remove infected lower leaves, apply fungicides, and rotate crops annually.

name: Tomato___Late_blight
cure: Apply preventive fungicides, ensure good spacing for airflow, and remove infected plants promptly.

name: Tomato___Leaf_Mold
cure: Improve greenhouse ventilation, reduce humidity, and apply appropriate fungicides.

name: Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot
cure: Remove affected leaves, mulch soil to prevent splash spread, and apply fungicides regularly.

name: Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider_mite
cure: Spray plants with water to reduce mites, use insecticidal soap or neem oil, and introduce natural predators like ladybugs.

name: Tomato___Target_Spot
cure: Apply fungicides at early infection, improve plant spacing, and remove infected debris.

name: Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus
cure: Control whiteflies using insecticides or sticky traps, remove infected plants, and use resistant varieties.

name: Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus
cause: Virus transmitted through contact and contaminated tools.
cure: Remove and destroy infected plants, disinfect tools regularly, and avoid handling plants when wet.

name: Tomato___healthy
cure: Continue proper watering, fertilization, staking, and routine inspection for pests and diseases.
